weather.location: Perseverance rover in Jezero crater. Regional observation; not measured at the hypothetical field stations.
weather.timeBasis: Local mean solar time (LMST) at the rover
weather.method: Exact nearest valid sample per channel within ±10 minutes of each 3-hour LMST bin. Channels may have different sample times. Gaps remain unavailable.
weather.quality: ATS_LOCAL_TEMP1 (K converted to °C), BAROCAP1_PRESSURE (Pa), BOOM1_HORIZONTAL_WIND_SPEED (m/s), wind only when control algorithm stable and rover still. Pressure/wind require a usable derived sample at the same SCLK, per SIS section 3.3.4. Empty cells and numeric fill sentinels excluded. Calibrated per-detector channels, not derived ambient estimates.

regional.title: Jezero regional traverse
regional.registration: Source Mars planetocentric east longitude/latitude transformed into the playable patch PDS equirectangular frame. Simplified to 10 m spacing, original leg endpoints retained.
regional.frame: Local east/north meters in the same CRS and origin as the playable terrain
